### Products & Professional Services
This section serves as the unified catalog combining production AI applications, digital toolkits, enterprise B2B corporate training, and lifetime career mentorship:

1. **Career Clarity App (AI Web Application):**
   - AI-powered ATS CV generator and resume diagnostic platform engineered to bypass automated ATS filters.
   - Link: https://careerclarity-app.vercel.app/
   - Features: Deterministic ATS Keyword Match Scoring, Actionable Competency Gap Fixes, Role Fit Analysis.

2. **Talent Up Career Acceleration Bootcamp (Career Mentorship):**
   - Lifetime access, pay-once comprehensive career mentorship program for fresh graduates, job seekers, and layoff survivors.
   - Link: https://talentup.myscalev.com/careerdevelopment
   - Track Record: Helped 1,000+ individuals land global remote & on-site positions.
   - Features: Weekly 1-on-1 CV/LinkedIn Audits, Live Mock Interviews with Global HR, Hiring Manager Referral Network.

3. **Job Apply AI (Productivity Engine):**
   - Web application delivering instant tailored cover letters, centralized application pipeline tracking, and recruiter outreach templates.
   - Features: Contextual Cover Letters, Multi-Company Job Tracker, LinkedIn Outreach Generator.

4. **HR Operations & KPI Starter Bundle (Digital Product Toolkit):**
   - Production-ready digital download containing 50+ standardized HR spreadsheets, Kirkpatrick 4-level training evaluation forms, leveling matrices, and onboarding SOPs.
   - Features: KPI & Balanced Scorecard Models, BNSP Level 4 Training Needs Analysis (TNA), STAR Interview Rubrics.

5. **Corporate Training & L&D Workshop (ToT BNSP Level 4):**
   - In-house corporate training and certified Training of Trainers (ToT) programs for corporate enterprises, startups, and higher education institutions.
   - Features: BNSP Level 4 Instructional Design, Kirkpatrick 4-Level Evaluation Framework, Flexible Delivery (Online, In-Person, or Hybrid).
   - Commercial Baseline: Corporate (Rp8.000.000 - Rp25.000.000), Startup/SME (from Rp4.000.000), University/Institutional (Rp2.000.000 - Rp3.000.000).

6. **Fractional HR Technology & Workflow Advisory (B2B Retainer):**
   - Strategic retainer consulting as Fractional Head of HR Tech: operational workflow audits, deterministic zero-cost automation engineering, and in-house LMS deployment without SaaS vendor lock-in.
   - Impact: Slashes HR administrative burden by 30% to 95%.

7. **1-on-1 Career & Executive Coaching:**
   - Dedicated private monthly coaching (4 sessions/month) for executives, career switchers, and corporate-sponsored talents.
   - Scope: Career trajectory strategy, executive presence, salary negotiation, and cross-border leadership.

## Featured Stories & Case Studies (`stories.html`)
URL: https://nugrohoamdalportfolio.dpdns.org/stories.html

### 1. Zero-Cost LMS & Deterministic Automation for 500+ Staff Across 26 Countries
- **Context:** Managing remote operations and cross-border team onboarding across 26 countries without high recurring per-seat SaaS costs.
- **Solution:** Designed and deployed a zero-cost LMS using Google Workspace infrastructure, Google Apps Script, and automated webhooks for TEI Recruitment.
- **Impact:**
  - Managed 100+ international trainees and 5-7 trainers simultaneously.
  - Lifted talent retention rate by +30%.
  - Zero recurring third-party software licensing overhead.

### 2. Mobile Performance Evaluation App (Apple App Store & Google Play Store)
- **Context:** Manual monthly performance evaluations across multiple educational branches took 48 hours to collect, calculate, and compile into leaderboards.
- **Solution:** Developed an internal mobile app published to Google Play Store and Apple App Store for real-time peer and superior appraisals.
- **Impact:**
  - Slashed compilation cycle from 48 hours to 15-30 minutes semi-realtime.
  - Transparent KPIs boosted team trust and accountability.
  - Awarded *Best HR of the Year 2023* (Mr. BOB Kampung Inggris).

### 3. Mentoring 150+ Aviation Cadets at Aeronef Academy & Jogja Flight
- **Context:** Cabin crew recruitment requires impeccable grooming, English fluency under pressure, and flawless behavioral presentation.
- **Solution:** Integrated BNSP Level 4 instructional methodology with rigorous mock interview panels and Aviation English pronunciation drills.
- **Impact:**
  - 150+ cadets successfully prepared for domestic and international airline recruitment drives (Garuda Indonesia, Lion Air Group, Citilink, AirAsia, Emirates, Qatar Airways).

### 4. Scaling Talent Up to 1,000+ Job Seekers & Professionals
- **Context:** Millions of graduates struggle with ATS filters and unstructured interview responses.
- **Solution:** Combined deterministic algorithmic scoring with personalized human feedback through Career Coach AI and intensive cohort bootcamps.
- **Impact:**
  - 1,000+ professionals and fresh graduates coached.
  - Average interview invitation rate increased from 8% to 42% within 30 days post-mentorship.

### 5. Beating ATS Screening with Career Clarity App
- **Context:** Fresh graduates and job seekers frequently face automatic rejections because standard resumes fail algorithmic ATS parsing.
- **Solution:** Career Clarity App (https://careerclarity-app.vercel.app/) uses Generative AI to diagnose keyword gaps and align resumes with global recruiter criteria.
- **Impact:** Eliminates ATS rejections and multiplies interview callback opportunities.

### 6. Layoff Recovery & Landing Global Remote Jobs via Talent Up Mentorship
- **Context:** Economic downturn and "tech winter" left seasoned workers and career switchers battling hiring age limits in domestic markets.
- **Solution:** Talent Up Career Development (https://talentup.myscalev.com/careerdevelopment) offers pay-once, lifetime access mentorship teaching multinational remote hiring secrets, STAR framing, and global outreach.
- **Impact:** 1,000+ alumni guided to cross-border remote and on-site dream roles.
